# PuffBreak

> PuffBreak (https://puffbreak.app) is a free, account-free, browser-based three-minute digital break room. Users can listen to human-curated global radio, sip virtual chai, settle into ASMR ambience, hang out anonymously, or use an optional virtual smoke ritual across 8 ambient environments.

For the complete reference, see: https://puffbreak.app/llms-full.txt
For original, self-reported break data (citable): https://puffbreak.app/data
Machine-readable data API: https://puffbreak.app/api/survey

## What it is

- A **virtual cigarette** with a multi-phase ignition animation (lighter or matchstick), physics-driven smoke, ash physics, and synthesized crackle audio.
- A **virtual chai / tea / coffee break** with a hold-to-sip mechanic and steam particles.
- **8 ambient rooms**: Office Rooftop, Beach Sunset, Space Station, Library Corner, Park Bench, Metro Platform, Chai Stall, Silent Room. Each has its own animated background, weather system, and procedural audio profile.
- **Human-curated live music radio** searchable by mood, genre, region, language, station, or artist, with saved favourites and a request flow.
- **Independent audio mixer** for radio, room ambience, and cigarette crackle, plus an intentionally silent room.
- **Procedural room audio engine** built on the Web Audio API (pink noise, filtered oscillators, and LFOs).
- **Anonymous live chat** per room (Firebase Realtime Database). Messages are ephemeral and expire; nicknames are random per session.
- **PWA** installable on iOS and Android. Runs on any modern browser.

## Music radio

- Feature page: https://puffbreak.app/radio
- PuffBreak includes curated global radio stations for intentional three-minute breaks.
- Editorial listening guides: https://puffbreak.app/radio/lofi · https://puffbreak.app/radio/indie · https://puffbreak.app/radio/indian-classical · https://puffbreak.app/radio/global-hits · https://puffbreak.app/radio/tame-impala-vibe · https://puffbreak.app/radio/chill-artist-radio · https://puffbreak.app/radio/pop-hip-hop-artist-radio · https://puffbreak.app/radio/desi-hip-hop · https://puffbreak.app/radio/global-cult-indie-radio · https://puffbreak.app/radio/indian-artist-radio · https://puffbreak.app/radio/best-internet-radio-2026
- Machine-readable catalogue: https://puffbreak.app/radio.json
- OPML subscription list: https://puffbreak.app/radio.opml
- The production catalogue spans global, North American, European, South Asian, East Asian, Middle Eastern, African, Latin American, and Oceanian music.
- It includes pop, rock, jazz, classical, lo-fi, hip-hop, R&B, Bollywood, bhajan, Pakistani pop, J-pop, K-pop, city pop, Afrobeats, amapiano, Latin urban, reggae, and artist-focused stations. Checked artist catalogues play inside PuffBreak rather than redirecting the play button to an external YouTube page.
- Kanye West Radio uses a verified continuous direct MP3 artist station; no YouTube video is loaded for that frequency.
- Desi hip-hop frequencies include KR$NA, Seedhe Maut, Raftaar, Talha Anjum, Karan Aujla and Sidhu Moose Wala. The first three use 50-song YouTube Music artist catalogues; Talha Anjum uses 25 checked tracks.
- Indian indie frequencies include Anuv Jain, Osho Jain, Lifafa, Peter Cat Recording Co., Divyam Sodhi and OAFF. A separate global cult-indie shelf covers 27 country and scene picks.
- Streams are operated by third-party stations. PuffBreak verifies audio delivery and browser/Web Audio compatibility before inclusion, but availability can change.

## Key facts

- Built with Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, motion (Framer Motion).
- Audio: Web Audio API procedural synthesis; particle effects: custom HTML5 Canvas engine.
- Backend: Firebase Realtime Database for ephemeral chat, presence, and aggregate counters only.
- Deployed on Vercel.
- Free, no ads, no accounts, no subscriptions.
- Privacy: no accounts or personal profiles; preferences in browser localStorage; aggregate analytics, temporary room messages, anonymous counters, and direct connections to selected third-party radio streams.

## Context and origin

PuffBreak is an English-language continuation of the "online damta" (담타) phenomenon — anonymous websites where strangers take virtual smoking breaks together, which went viral in South Korea in 2023. PuffBreak adds ambient rooms, procedural audio, virtual chai, and a global community. See https://puffbreak.app/regions/damta for the cultural background.

## Original data (survey)

PuffBreak collects an optional, anonymous, single-tap self-report after each completed break: "Did this break reduce your craving?" (options: Gone / Eased / Same / Worse). One response per browser session. The aggregate is published unedited at /data and exposed as JSON at /api/survey. This is self-reported, non-clinical data — a behavioral signal, not medical research.
